lines.text: الكواكب المتقدِّمة{n:1} فإِذا تَمَّتْ ثمانية أُسْقِطَتْ وأُخِذَ ما زاد على ثمانية بعينه فزِيدَ على مواضع الكواكب
lines.plain: الكواكب المتقدِّمة فإِذا تَمَّتْ ثمانية أُسْقِطَتْ وأُخِذَ ما زاد على ثمانية بعينه فزِيدَ على مواضع الكواكب

lines.text: الى تمام ثمانية ثمّ يُعاد الامر الاوّل وكان زمان السنة الذي كان يعمَل عليه هٰؤُلاء الذين ذهَبوا هذا
lines.plain: الى تمام ثمانية ثمّ يُعاد الامر الاوّل وكان زمان السنة الذي كان يعمَل عليه هٰؤُلاء الذين ذهَبوا هذا

lines.text: المَذْهَب اكثر من {ov:شسه} يومًا ورُبْع يوم بمقدار خُمْس ساعة ونَحْوَه فتقَع لذلك حَرَكة الشمس الوُسْطَى
lines.plain: المَذْهَب اكثر من شسه يومًا ورُبْع يوم بمقدار خُمْس ساعة ونَحْوَه فتقَع لذلك حَرَكة الشمس الوُسْطَى

lines.text: في السنة المصريّة {ov:شنط} {ov:مد} {ov:مج}{n:2} وأمّا إِبَّرْخُس{n:3} وهو بَعْدَ هٰؤلاء فعمِل على أنّ زمان السنة {ov:شسه} يومًا
lines.plain: في السنة المصريّة شنط مد مج وأمّا إِبَّرْخُس وهو بَعْدَ هٰؤلاء فعمِل على أنّ زمان السنة شسه يومًا

lines.text: ورُبْع يوم فقط فتقَع حركة الشمس في زمان السنة المصريّة {ov:شنط} {ov:مه} {ov:يج}{n:4} وكان يزعَم انّه قد وقَف{mR:5}
lines.plain: ورُبْع يوم فقط فتقَع حركة الشمس في زمان السنة المصريّة شنط مه يج وكان يزعَم انّه قد وقَف

lines.text: على انّه اقلّ من الرُّبْع يوم. ثمّ رصَد بطلميوس من بَعْدِ إِبَّرْخُس{n:5} بمائتَيْن وخمس وثمانين سنة فوجَد
lines.plain: على انّه اقلّ من الرُّبْع يوم. ثمّ رصَد بطلميوس من بَعْدِ إِبَّرْخُس بمائتَيْن وخمس وثمانين سنة فوجَد

lines.text: زمان السنة فيما عمِل عليه {ov:شسه} يومًا واقلّ من رُبْع يوم بجُزْء من ثلثمائة فكانت لذلك حركة الشمس
lines.plain: زمان السنة فيما عمِل عليه شسه يومًا واقلّ من رُبْع يوم بجُزْء من ثلثمائة فكانت لذلك حركة الشمس

lines.text: في السنة المصريّة {ov:شنط} {ov:مه}{n:6} {ov:كه} ورصَدنا نحن بعد بطلميوس بسبعمائة{n:7} وثلٰث واربعين سنة فوجدنا زمان
lines.plain: في السنة المصريّة شنط مه كه ورصَدنا نحن بعد بطلميوس بسبعمائة وثلٰث واربعين سنة فوجدنا زمان

lines.text: السنة {ov:شسه} يومًا واقلّ من رُبْع يوم بثلثة اجزاء وخُمْسَيْ جُزْء من ثلثمائة وستّين فصارت حركة الشمس
lines.plain: السنة شسه يومًا واقلّ من رُبْع يوم بثلثة اجزاء وخُمْسَيْ جُزْء من ثلثمائة وستّين فصارت حركة الشمس

lines.text: لذلك في السنة المصريّة {ov:شنط} {ov:مه} {ov:مو} فهذه الحركات كلّها متزيّدة من لَدُن زمان بُخْتَنَصَّرَ ونحوه فقد{mR:10}
lines.plain: لذلك في السنة المصريّة شنط مه مو فهذه الحركات كلّها متزيّدة من لَدُن زمان بُخْتَنَصَّرَ ونحوه فقد

lines.text: بطَل ان يكون هذا الذي وصَفوا مُوافِقًا لشيء من قوْلهم في كَمِّيّة الاجزاء ولا في مقدار الحركة ولا
lines.plain: بطَل ان يكون هذا الذي وصَفوا مُوافِقًا لشيء من قوْلهم في كَمِّيّة الاجزاء ولا في مقدار الحركة ولا

lines.text: في التزايُد والتناقُص ولكنّا نَرَى هذا التزيُّد يكون على غير ترتيب في الإِبْطاء والسُّرْعة وذلك أنّ
lines.plain: في التزايُد والتناقُص ولكنّا نَرَى هذا التزيُّد يكون على غير ترتيب في الإِبْطاء والسُّرْعة وذلك أنّ

lines.text: بطلميوس استدرك على إِبَّرْخُس{n:8} في زُهاء ثلثمائة سنة قريبًا من يَوْم واستدركنا نحن على بطلميوس في
lines.plain: بطلميوس استدرك على إِبَّرْخُس في زُهاء ثلثمائة سنة قريبًا من يَوْم واستدركنا نحن على بطلميوس في

lines.text: زُهاء سبعمائة وخمسين سنة *مقدار اربعة ايّام ورُبْع سِوَى اليوم الذي كان هو قد استدركه على{mL:f. 129,v.}
lines.plain: زُهاء سبعمائة وخمسين سنة *مقدار اربعة ايّام ورُبْع سِوَى اليوم الذي كان هو قد استدركه على

lines.text: إِبّرخس{n:9} وإِن يكُنْ{n:10} هذه الزيادة إِنّما وقَعت من قِبَل خَطَأ وقَع في الآلات التي رُصِدَ بها من قِبَل{mR:15}
lines.plain: إِبّرخس وإِن يكُنْ هذه الزيادة إِنّما وقَعت من قِبَل خَطَأ وقَع في الآلات التي رُصِدَ بها من قِبَل

lines.text: قسْمتها او تغيُّرها على طول الزمان فقد يَجِب ضَرورةً أن تقَع{n:11} في أرصادنا بعد مُدّة من الزمان اذ
lines.plain: قسْمتها او تغيُّرها على طول الزمان فقد يَجِب ضَرورةً أن تقَع في أرصادنا بعد مُدّة من الزمان اذ

lines.text: كانت قِياساتنا في أرصادنا إِنّما هي الى تلك الأرصاد وإِن كان ذلك من قِبَل حَرَكة في الفَلَك لم
lines.plain: كانت قِياساتنا في أرصادنا إِنّما هي الى تلك الأرصاد وإِن كان ذلك من قِبَل حَرَكة في الفَلَك لم

lines.text: تظهَر لنا حقيقتها ولم نُحِطْ بمعرفتها نحن ولا غيرنا من المتقدِّمين فإِنَّ طَلَب الحَقّ وأتباعه أن يُرْصَد في
lines.plain: تظهَر لنا حقيقتها ولم نُحِطْ بمعرفتها نحن ولا غيرنا من المتقدِّمين فإِنَّ طَلَب الحَقّ وأتباعه أن يُرْصَد في

lines.text: كلّ زمان فما وُجِدَ من شيء واُسْتُدْرِكَ فيه اصلح كما اصلح في الزمان الذي قَبْلَه. وأمّا ما يقَع به الظَّنّ
lines.plain: كلّ زمان فما وُجِدَ من شيء واُسْتُدْرِكَ فيه اصلح كما اصلح في الزمان الذي قَبْلَه. وأمّا ما يقَع به الظَّنّ

lines.text: ويُوجِبُه{n:12} القياس فإِنّه لمّا كانت هذه الزيادة شاملة في جميع حركات الكواكب كلّها إِنّ ذلك إِنّما وقَع{mR:20}
lines.plain: ويُوجِبُه القياس فإِنّه لمّا كانت هذه الزيادة شاملة في جميع حركات الكواكب كلّها إِنّ ذلك إِنّما وقَع

lines.text: من قِبَل حركة فلك الكواكب الثابتة وذلك أنّ بطلميوس ذكَر أنّ هذه الحركة فيما وجَد بأَرصاده وعلى
lines.plain: من قِبَل حركة فلك الكواكب الثابتة وذلك أنّ بطلميوس ذكَر أنّ هذه الحركة فيما وجَد بأَرصاده وعلى

6) Cod. مد — 7) Cod. بتسع مايه — 8) Cod. برخس — 9) Cod. برخس — 10) Cod. يكون — 11) Forte

observations: L01, L02, L04, L05, L06, L07, L12, L14, L15: long joins (مواضـع on L01; هـذا at the end of L02; زمـان on L04; قـد on L05; فوجَـد at the end of L06; رُبْـع on L07; غـير and وذلـك on L12; هـو and قـد on L14; وقَـع and, at the end of the line, قِبَـل on L15) are not transcribed; nor the long kāf of حَرَكة (L03, L17).

The page continues chapter 52: twenty-one lines of text, a rule and three lines of notes; it has no signature. The lines run the full measure; the block leans a little to the right as it goes down: the lines begin at 528.7 pt on L01 and at 534.4 pt on L21, and end at 105.7 pt on L01 and at 110.7 pt on L21. The baselines stand from 125.6 to 659.2 pt down. Nallino's line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 stand in the right margin beside L05, L10, L15 and L20 (536.8 to 551.2 pt); the folio number «f. 129,v.» stands in the left margin beside L14 (71.3 to 101.5 pt), where the asterisk (5.0 x 5.4 pt) stands before مقدار. The rule runs from 110.2 to 211.0 pt (100.8 pt), 685.4 to 687.6 pt down; the note lines stand 713.2, 728.6 and 743.8 pt down, the first from 137.5 to 536.0 pt, the second from 110.2 to 536.0 pt and the third from 110.5 to 247.7 pt. Two full stops stand in the text: after يوم on L06 and after قَبْلَه on L19 (2.5 x 2.9 pt each). A mark of the scan at the lower left (27 to 40 pt, 819 pt down) is not part of the page. The line finding took the bars over the numerals of L08 for a line of their own (baseline 300.6 pt); that line is dropped.

The numerals: sixteen groups of letters, each under its own bar. شسه (365) stands four times, on L03, L04 (near the end of the line), L07 and L09 (bars 12.4, 13.3, 12.5 and 14.5 pt). The four yearly motions of the sun are of three groups each: شنط مد مج (359;44,43) on L04 (bars 12.4, 13.3 and 12.8 pt), شنط مه يج (359;45,13) on L05 (12.8, 12.8 and 12.6 pt), شنط مه كه (359;45,25) on L08 (13.6, 13.6 and 13.0 pt) and شنط مه مو (359;45,46) on L10 (13.1, 13.2 and 13.4 pt). The sort of مج on L04 (7.7 x 11.0 pt) has the knot of the mīm at the head of the bowl and the round dot of the jīm in the bowl (1.4 x 1.6 pt), and no other dot; the sort of يج on L05 (7.6 x 11.0 pt) has in the bowl the flat dot of the yā' (2.2 x 1.6 pt) and beside it the small round dot of the jīm (1.0 x 1.1 pt). In شنط the three dots of the shīn are one cluster (2.3 to 2.5 x 2.4 to 2.9 pt) and the dot of the nūn is small (1.2 to 1.4 pt). The four readings agree with the lengths of the year given in the text: 360 degrees in 365 days, for a year of 365 days and a quarter and a fifth of an hour, of 365 days and a quarter, of 365 days and a quarter less one part of 300, and of 365 days and a quarter less 3 2/5 parts of 360, come to 359;44,43, 359;45,13, 359;45,25 and 359;45,46.

The note figures: twelve. 1 after المتقدِّمة (L01); 2 after the numeral and 3 after إِبَّرْخُس (L04); 4 after the numeral (L05); 5 after إِبَّرْخُس (L06); 6 on L08 between the second and the third group of the numeral, in the gap between their bars (415.2 to 424.3 pt); 7 after بسبعمائة (L08); 8 after إِبَّرْخُس (L13); 9 after إِبّرخس and 10 after يكُنْ (L15), the sukun of the nūn standing at the right of the figure 10; 11 after تقَع (L16); 12 after ويُوجِبُه (L20).

The notes: eleven give readings of the codex and note 11 proposes an addition. Note 2: مد مح, the second group being the sort with the knot of the mīm at the head of the ḥā', without a dot (compare مج in the text). Note 3 gives the name with the signs of the codex: بُرْخَسْ, a damma over the bā' (2.5 x 3.6 pt), a small sukun over the rā' (1.8 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the khā' (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a small sukun over the sīn (1.8 x 2.2 pt); notes 5, 8 and 9 have برخس without signs. Note 4: شنط ما نج, with the dot of the nūn over the tooth and the dot of the jīm in the bowl. Note 6: مد. Note 7: بتسع مايه, in two words and without a hamza. Note 11: خطأٌ: at the left of the top of the alif the hamza with a dammatan above it in one cluster (4.3 x 5.8 pt), in both copies. Note 12: يوحيه: the flat dot of the yā' stands under the first letter and under the tooth before the hā' (2.2 x 1.4 pt each) and the ḥā' has no dot, in both copies; the text has ويُوجِبُه.

L01: المتقدِّمة: a shadda over the dāl (3.6 x 2.9 pt) with a kasra under the letter (3.6 x 2.2 pt); so too المتقدِّمين on L18 (3.2 x 2.5 and 3.6 x 1.4 pt). فإِذا: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.2 x 5.0 pt). تَمَّتْ: over the ligature of the tā' and the mīm, above the two dots of the tā', one cluster of a fatha and of a shadda with a fatha above it (5.8 x 6.1 pt), and a round sukun over the two dots of the last tā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt). أُسْقِطَتْ: over the alif the hamza with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 6.1 pt), a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a kasra under the qāf (4.0 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the ṭā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the two dots of the tā' (2.5 x 3.2 pt). وأُخِذَ: over the alif the hamza with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 6.1 pt), a kasra under the khā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the dhāl (4.0 x 2.5 pt). فزِيدَ: a kasra under the zāy (4.0 x 2.2 pt), at the right of the two dots of the yā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt), and a fatha over the dāl (4.0 x 2.5 pt).

L02: الى, الامر and الاوّل: no hamza; so too الى on L17. ثمّ: a shadda over the mīm (3.2 x 2.5 pt); so too on L06 (3.6 x 2.5 pt). يُعاد: a damma over the yā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt). الاوّل: a shadda over the wāw (3.2 x 2.2 pt). يعمَل: a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt). هٰؤُلاء: a small upright alif over the hā' (1.8 x 4.0 pt) and over the wāw the hamza with a damma above it in one cluster (3.2 x 6.5 pt); the hamza at the end stands on the line. الذين: the two dots of the yā' are joined to the foot of the letter, in both copies. ذهَبوا: a fatha over the hā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt).

L03: المَذْهَب: a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt), and over the hā', at the left of the dot of the dhāl, a round sukun and a fatha joined in one mark (6.5 x 3.2 pt), in both copies. اكثر: no hamza. يومًا: the fathatan (3.6 x 3.2 pt); so too on L04 (3.6 x 2.9 pt), L07 (3.6 x 3.2 pt) and L09 (3.6 x 2.9 pt); on L04 and on L09 the two dots of the yā' are joined to the foot of the letter. ورُبْع: a damma over the rā' (2.5 x 5.0 pt) and a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt); so too on L05 (2.2 x 4.3 and 2.5 x 2.9 pt) and on L14 (2.5 x 4.7 and 2.5 x 2.5 pt), and رُبْع on L07 (2.2 x 5.0 and 2.5 x 2.9 pt) and on L09 (2.5 x 4.7 pt and a narrow sukun, 1.8 x 2.5 pt). خُمْس: a small damma over the dot of the khā' (2.2 x 3.6 pt) and a round sukun over the mīm (2.5 x 2.5 pt). ونَحْوَه: a fatha over the dot of the nūn (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the ḥā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a fatha over the wāw (3.6 x 2.2 pt); ونحوه on L10 has no signs. فتقَع: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.5 pt); so too on L05 (4.0 x 2.5 pt). حَرَكة: a fatha over the ḥā' (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt); so too on L17 (3.6 x 2.5 pt each); حركة on L05, L07, L09 and L21 and الحركة on L11 and L21 have no signs. الوُسْطَى: a damma over the wāw (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a fatha over the ṭā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt).

L04: المصريّة: a shadda over the yā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt); so too on L05 (3.2 x 2.9 pt), L08 (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and L10 (3.2 x 2.5 pt). وأمّا: the bare hamza on the top of the alif (2.9 x 2.9 pt) and a shadda over the mīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt); so too on L19 (2.9 x 3.2 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt). إِبَّرْخُس: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.2 x 5.0 pt), over the bā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 pt each), a round sukun over the rā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a damma over the dot of the khā' (2.9 x 5.0 pt); the dot of the bā' is joined to the foot of the ligature of the bā' and the rā', here and the three other times. بَعْدَ: a fatha over the bā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.2 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the dāl (2.9 x 1.8 pt); بعد on L08 and on L16 has no signs. هٰؤلاء: a small upright alif over the hā' (1.4 x 3.2 pt) and the bare hamza over the wāw (2.9 x 3.2 pt), without the damma of L02. فعمِل: a kasra under the mīm (3.6 x 1.8 pt); a small mark under the fā' in the master scan (1.4 x 2.5 pt) is not in the second copy. أنّ: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.6 x 2.2 pt).

L05: يزعَم: a fatha over the ʿayn (3.6 x 2.2 pt); the two dots of the yā' are cast in the join with the zāy. انّه: a shadda over the dot of the nūn (3.2 x 2.5 pt) and no hamza; so too on L06 (3.2 x 2.5 pt). وقَف: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt).

L06: اقلّ: a shadda over the lām (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and no hamza; so too واقلّ on L07 (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and on L09 (3.2 x 2.5 pt). الرُّبْع: over the rā' a shadda with a damma above it (3.2 x 2.5 and 2.5 x 4.3 pt) and a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt). رصَد: a fatha over the ṣād (3.6 x 2.2 pt). بَعْدِ: a fatha over the bā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under the dāl (3.6 x 2.2 pt). إِبَّرْخُس: under the alif the hamza (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a kasra under it (3.6 x 2.2 pt), apart from each other; over the bā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the rā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a damma over the dot of the khā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt). بمائتَيْن: a small hamza over the tooth after the alif (2.5 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt), whose two dots stand under the line. فوجَد: a fatha over the jīm (3.6 x 2.5 pt); فوجدنا on L08 has no signs.

L07: عمِل: a short kasra under the mīm (2.9 x 1.4 pt). بجُزْء: a damma over the jīm (2.5 x 5.0 pt), a round sukun over the dot of the zāy (2.2 x 2.5 pt) and the hamza on the line (2.9 x 3.2 pt); so too جُزْء on L09 (2.5 x 5.0, 2.5 x 2.5 and 2.5 x 3.2 pt). ثلثمائة: the hamza over the tooth after the alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt), and no sign over the lām; so too on L09 and on L13 (2.9 x 3.2 pt each).

L08: ورصَدنا: a fatha over the ṣād (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and no sukun over the dāl. بسبعمائة: the sīn is weakly printed, its teeth a thin line apart from the letters beside it (5.3 x 2.0 pt); the hamza over the tooth after the alif (2.5 x 2.9 pt); so too the hamza of سبعمائة on L14 (2.9 x 2.9 pt). وثلٰث: a small upright alif over the lām (1.4 x 3.6 pt), in both copies; the lām under it has its full height, as in ثلثمائة on L07 and in بثلثة on L09, which have no such sign. واربعين: no hamza; so too اربعة on L14.

L09: وخُمْسَيْ: a damma over the dot of the khā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the mīm (2.2 x 2.9 pt), a fatha over the sīn (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt), whose two dots stand under the line (3.2 x 2.2 pt). اجزاء: the hamza on the line; no hamza on the first alif; so too الاجزاء on L11. وستّين: a shadda over the two dots of the tā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt).

L10: كلّها: a shadda over the lām (3.2 x 2.5 pt); so too on L20 (3.6 x 2.5 pt). متزيّدة: a shadda over the yā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and no kasra; under the line stand only the two dots of the yā'. لَدُن: a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a damma over the dāl (2.5 x 4.7 pt); no sukun over the nūn. بُخْتَنَصَّرَ: a damma over the bā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the khā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the dot of the nūn (3.6 x 2.2 pt), over the ṣād a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt); on p. 190 the name has no sign over the rā'. الحركات: a speck in the angle of the kāf in the master scan (1.1 x 1.3 pt) is not in the second copy.

L11: بطَل: a fatha over the ṭā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). ان: no hamza. وصَفوا: a fatha over the ṣād (3.6 x 2.2 pt). مُوافِقًا: a damma over the mīm (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a short kasra under the fā' (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and the fathatan (3.6 x 3.2 pt). لشيء: the hamza on the line; so too شيء on L19. قوْلهم: a round sukun over the wāw (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and no fatha, as on p. 190. كَمِّيّة: a fatha over the kāf (3.6 x 1.8 pt), a shadda over the mīm (3.2 x 2.5 pt) with a kasra under the letter (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a shadda over the yā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt).

L12: التزايُد: a damma over the yā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt). والتناقُص: a damma over the two dots of the qāf (2.2 x 4.7 pt). ولكنّا: a shadda over the dot of the nūn (3.6 x 2.5 pt). نَرَى: a fatha over the dot of the nūn (4.0 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt). التزيُّد: over the yā' a shadda with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 6.5 pt). الإِبْطاء: under the lām-alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.2 x 4.3 pt) and a round sukun over the bā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt); the hamza at the end stands on the line. والسُّرْعة: over the sīn a shadda with a damma above it in one cluster (3.2 x 6.5 pt) and a round sukun over the rā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). أنّ: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 2.9 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.2 x 2.5 pt).

L13: إِبَّرْخُس: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt), over the bā' a shadda with a fatha above it (2.9 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the rā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a damma over the dot of the khā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt). استدرك and واستدركنا: no signs; so too استدركه on L14. زُهاء: a damma over the dot of the zāy (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and the hamza on the line; so too on L14 (2.5 x 4.7 pt). قريبًا: the fathatan (3.6 x 3.2 pt). يَوْم: a fatha over the yā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the wāw (2.5 x 2.9 pt); يوم on L03, L05, L06, L07 and L09 has no signs.
L14: ايّام: a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt) and no hamza. سِوَى: a kasra under the sīn (2.9 x 2.2 pt) and a short fatha over the wāw (2.9 x 1.4 pt).

L15: إِبّرخس: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (4.0 x 4.7 pt) and a shadda over the bā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt); no fatha, no sukun and no damma, in both copies (compare L04, L06 and L13). وإِن: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.6 x 5.0 pt); so too on L17 (3.2 x 4.7 pt). يكُنْ: a damma over the kāf (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the nūn (2.5 x 2.5 pt). إِنّما: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (2.9 x 4.7 pt) and a shadda over the dot of the nūn (3.2 x 2.2 pt), without a fatha; so too on L17 (3.2 x 4.7 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt) and on L20 (3.6 x 4.7 and 2.9 x 2.2 pt). وقَعت: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.2 x 2.2 pt). قِبَل: a kasra under the qāf (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the bā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt); so too at the end of the line (2.9 x 1.8 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt) and on L17 (3.2 x 1.8 and 3.6 x 1.8 pt). خَطَأ: a fatha over the khā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the ṭā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 2.9 pt). وقَع: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt); so too on L20 (3.6 x 2.2 pt). الآلات: the madda over the lām-alif (9.4 x 3.6 pt). رُصِدَ: a damma over the rā' (2.5 x 4.3 pt), a kasra under the ṣād (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the dāl (4.0 x 2.2 pt).

L16: قسْمتها: a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and no kasra under the qāf. او: no hamza; the alif is broken in two (its upper part 1.8 x 5.0 pt), in both copies. تغيُّرها: over the yā' a shadda with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 6.5 pt). يَجِب: a fatha over the yā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under the jīm (3.2 x 1.8 pt). ضَرورةً: a fatha over the ḍād (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and the fathatan over the two dots of the tā' marbūṭa (3.6 x 3.2 pt). أن: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 2.9 pt); so too on L18 (2.5 x 2.9 pt). تقَع: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt); so too يقَع on L19 (3.6 x 2.2 pt). أرصادنا: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 2.9 pt); so too on L17 (2.9 x 2.9 pt) and الأرصاد on L17 (2.9 x 2.9 pt). مُدّة: a damma over the mīm (2.9 x 5.0 pt) and a shadda over the dāl (3.2 x 2.2 pt). اذ: no hamza.

L17: قِياساتنا: a short kasra under the qāf (2.5 x 1.8 pt), at the right of the two dots of the yā' (4.0 x 2.5 pt). الفَلَك: a fatha over the dot of the fā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the lām (2.9 x 1.8 pt).

L18: تظهَر: a fatha over the hā' (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and no sign over the tā'. نُحِطْ: a damma over the dot of the nūn (2.9 x 4.7 pt), a kasra under the ḥā' (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun on the top of the ṭā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt). فإِنَّ: under the alif the hamza (2.2 x 2.9 pt) and a kasra under it (3.2 x 2.2 pt), apart from each other, and over the nūn a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.5 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt). طَلَب: a fatha over the ṭā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 2.2 pt). الحَقّ: a fatha over the ḥā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a shadda over the qāf, at the left of its two dots (3.2 x 2.5 pt). وأتباعه: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 2.9 pt). يُرْصَد: a damma over the yā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the rā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the ṣād (3.6 x 2.2 pt); the two dots of the yā' are cast in the join with the rā'.

L19: كلّ: a shadda over the lām (3.6 x 2.5 pt). وُجِدَ: a damma over the wāw (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a kasra under the jīm (2.9 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the dāl (3.2 x 1.8 pt). واُسْتُدْرِكَ: a damma on the top of the alif (3.2 x 2.9 pt), without a hamza, a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a damma over the two dots of the tā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the dāl (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the kāf (3.2 x 2.2 pt). اصلح (twice): no signs. قَبْلَه: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a fatha over the lām (3.2 x 1.8 pt). الظَّنّ: over the ẓā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 pt each) and a shadda over the nūn (3.2 x 2.5 pt).

L20: ويُوجِبُه: a damma over the yā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a short kasra under the dot of the jīm (2.9 x 1.8 pt), at the left of the two dots of the yā', and a damma over the bā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt). فإِنّه: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.2 x 4.7 pt) and a shadda over the dot of the nūn (3.2 x 2.5 pt). لمّا: a shadda over the mīm (3.2 x 2.5 pt). إِنّ: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.6 x 5.0 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.2 x 2.5 pt).

L21: قِبَل: a kasra under the qāf (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and a short fatha over the bā', above the left end of the two dots of the qāf (2.2 x 1.8 pt), in both copies. أنّ (twice): the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 3.2 and 2.9 x 3.6 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.2 x 2.5 and 2.9 x 2.2 pt). ذكَر: a fatha over the kāf (3.6 x 2.5 pt). وجَد: a fatha over the jīm (4.0 x 2.5 pt). بأَرصاده: the hamza with a fatha above it, joined to the top of the alif.
